jobs.occupation: Engineering High-Maize for Improved Mineral Bioavailability through Gene Editing and Protein Design
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Agroecology programme. The position is available from 01 April 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Engineering High-Phytase Maize for Improved Mineral Bioavailability through Gene Editing and Protein Design

Research area and project description
Phosphorus stored in cereal grains is largely present as phytate, a compound that strongly binds essential minerals such as iron and zinc, thereby reducing their bioavailability in food and feed. Increasing phytase activity in grain represents a promising strategy to improve mineral nutrition while reducing the environ-mental footprint of agricultural production.

The PhD project is part of the GRAINPAP initiative at Aarhus University, Department for Agroecology, Section for Crop Genetics and Biotechnology. The project aims to develop maize germplasm with enhanced mature grain phytase activity through a combination of genome editing, molecular genetics, biotechnology and computational biology.

The successful candidate will investigate members of the Purple Acid Phosphatase (PAP) gene family and apply CRISPR-based promoter engineering and gene editing approaches to increase grain-specific phytase expression. The project will furthermore explore protein engineering strategies to optimize enzyme performance and will utilize genomic and transcriptomic datasets to identify regulatory mechanisms controlling phytase accumulation in grain.

The PhD student will receive training in genome editing, molecular cloning, plant transformation, bioinformatics, functional genomics and biochemical characterization of enzymes. The project includes collaboration with leading researchers in plant biotechnology and computational genetics and provides access to state-of-the-art laboratory, greenhouse and field facilities.

The position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of more nutritious and sustainable crop varieties while obtaining broad interdisciplinary skills at the interface of plant genetics, molecular biology and crop biotechnology.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in disciplines such as Agricultural Sciences, Molecular Biology, Plant Biotechnology, Plant Science or similar. Experience working with cereal crops, genome editing technologies, and plant transformation systems will be considered a strong advantage.

We expect that you:
 
• Have good communication skills in English, written and oral.
• Are motivated for both experimental work and scientific writing.
• Can work both independently and collaboratively
• Thrive in an informal collaborative workspace
Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Agroecology, Section for Crop Genetics and Biotechnology, Research Center Flakkebjerg, Forsøgsvej 1, DK-4200 Slagelse, Denmark.

Contacts:
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
 
• Henrik Brinch-Pedersen, hbp@agro.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Sandip M. Kale, smkale@agro.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk
How to apply:
Please follow this link to submit your application. Application deadline is 05 January 2027 CET. Preferred starting date is 01 April 2027.
For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please simply copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which everyone has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

jobs.occupation: Senior AI engineer
jobs.description:

With 20+ years of successful Google Cloud implementations and a team of certified experts, we drive digital transformation across various industries. We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, providing you with the tools and support you need to excel in your career.

At Devoteam, we champion a revolutionary “New Way of Work” that prioritizes flexibility, personal growth, and joint success.

Curious about our projects? We got you: Check out our success stories

Job Description

We are looking for a strong AI Engineer (Senior to Principal level) to join our Applied AI Studio. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy bespoke, production-grade AI solutions for our Nordic clients. You will own the full lifecycle – from solution architecture and model orchestration to scalable backend services, user-facing integration, and MLOps – while acting as a trusted technical advisor to both clients and internal teams.

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Eata engineers, Cloud Engineers, UX designers, project, change and product managers, and Google experts to solve complex problems and deliver measurable impact.

•

• 
Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Guide junior colleagues in AI engineering best practices, champion knowledge sharing, and foster a culture of continuous learning within the studio.

• 
Stay Ahead of the Curve: Continuously explore emerging AI capabilities, frameworks, and architectural patterns to keep our studio at the forefront of the industry.

Qualifications

Core Experience & Skills

• 
End-to-End Fullstack & Software Engineering: Proven track record building production software end-to-end. Python is a must, with strong experience in backend/API development and integrating AI into complete applications.

• 
Solution Architecture: Experience designing scalable, secure, and maintainable system architectures for AI-powered products.

AI & Agentic Frameworks: Hands-on experience with ADK, PyTorch, LangChain, and LangGraph.

• 
MLOps & Cloud: Experience with MLOps practices (deployment, monitoring, evaluation, CI/CD for AI/ML), preferably on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• 
Communication & Leadership: Strong ability to communicate with both technical peers and executive client stakeholders, paired with a passion for mentoring.

• 
Fluent in English, both spoken and written (proficiency in any other Nordic language is a plus).

Nice to Have

• 
Proficiency in additional programming languages such as Go (Golang) or C#.

• 
Experience working in client-facing consulting or studio environments across the Nordics.

Additional Information

Why Join the Applied AI Studio?

• 
Work on diverse, high-impact AI projects with leading Nordic organizations.

• 
Collaborate directly with multidisciplinary teams and Google experts.

• 
Shape architectural standards, mentor growing talent, and work with the latest tools in applied AI.

jobs.occupation: DOORMAN
jobs.description:
D’ANGLETERRE IS SEARCHING FOR A FULL-TIME DOORMAN

At d’Angleterre, the guest experience begins before a guest even steps inside the hotel.

We are looking for a warm, confident and attentive Doorman to join our Front Office team. As one of the first people our guests meet and one of the last they see when they leave, you play an important role in creating the lasting impression they take with them.

This role is about much more than opening doors. You represent d’Angleterre through genuine hospitality, personal recognition and an ability to anticipate what each guest may need.

ABOUT THE JOB

As our Doorman, you will create seamless and personalised arrival and departure experiences while ensuring the hotel entrance operates smoothly.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Welcoming hotel, restaurant and event guests with warmth and genuine personal attention

• Recognising returning guests and anticipating individual needs

• Opening hotel and car doors, assisting with luggage and guiding guests to their destination

• Parking and retrieving guest vehicles safely and handling keys with care

• Coordinating taxis, transfers and guest movement with Concierge, Reception and the luggage team

• Staying informed about arrivals, departures, VIP guests and inhouse events to help personalise the experience

• Sharing relevant guest preferences and requests with colleagues to ensure seamless service

• Providing knowledgeable information about the hotel and Copenhagen

• Maintaining a welcoming, polished and safe hotel entrance

• Taking ownership of guest requests and consistently representing the service and discretion expected at d’Angleterre

ABOUT YOU

You have a natural ability to make people feel welcome. You are warm and approachable while remaining polished, professional and attentive to detail.

Experience from a luxury hotel or another high-end guest-facing environment is preferred, but your personality and instinct for hospitality are just as important.

You remain calm in a busy environment, communicate confidently in English and enjoy working as part of a team. Danish and other languages are an advantage, as is a good knowledge of Copenhagen.

A valid driving licence suitable for driving guest vehicles in Denmark is required, and you must be comfortable parking different types of vehicles.

The position includes flexible shifts across days, afternoons and weekends.

WE OFFER

You will join one of Copenhagen’s most iconic luxury hotels and become part of an ambitious team dedicated to creating exceptional and personalised guest experiences.

As Doorman, you hold a particularly visible place within that experience.

You are not simply standing at the entrance to d’Angleterre. You are representing it.

ABOUT HOTEL D’ANGLETERRE

For more than 265 years, Hotel d’Angleterre has welcomed guests in the heart of Copenhagen. Today, we continue to combine our heritage with an ambition to develop and set new standards for luxury hospitality.

We believe exceptional service is ultimately about how we make people feel. And often, that experience begins with the person at the door.

jobs.occupation: Executive Housekeeping Manager
jobs.description:
Are you an inspiring and hands-on leader with a passion for luxury hospitality, impeccable standards and creating exceptional guest experiences?

Hotel d’Angleterre is looking for an experienced Executive Housekeeping Manager to lead our Housekeeping Department and take overall responsibility for the presentation, care and continuous development of our guestrooms, suites and public areas.

About the role

As Executive Housekeeping Manager, you will be responsible for the overall leadership and operation of the Housekeeping Department. You will combine a strong operational presence with a continuous focus on the guest experience, quality, people development and efficiency.

You will create a respectful, motivated and high-performing team culture, while ensuring sound financial management, efficient operations and consistently exceptional standards throughout the hotel.

A key part of your role will be to uphold and continuously develop our Housekeeping standards, ensuring that every guestroom and public area reflects the quality and attention to detail expected at d’Angleterre. You will ensure that LQA requirements and our own service standards are translated into daily behaviours and consistently maintained through training, coaching, inspections and quality follow-up.

Beyond maintaining standards, you will take an active role in developing how we work. You will identify opportunities to improve the guest experience, protect the quality of our physical product and strengthen the efficiency and effectiveness of the department.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading, developing and inspiring the Housekeeping team, creating a culture of accountability, pride, collaboration and continuous learning

• Recruiting, onboarding, coaching and developing colleagues and future Housekeeping leaders

• Planning staffing and schedules in line with occupancy, arrivals, departures, events and operational demands

• Ensuring impeccable standards across guestrooms, suites, public areas and back-of-house spaces

• Taking ownership of the presentation, condition and continuous improvement of the Housekeeping product

• Ensuring thoughtful preparation for VIP arrivals, repeat guests, special occasions and individual guest preferences

• Leading ongoing training, coaching and quality follow-up, including LQA standards, room inspections and luxury service behaviours

• Establishing structured deep-cleaning and preventive maintenance programmes in close collaboration with Engineering

• Conducting regular quality inspections and translating guest feedback and quality results into meaningful improvements

• Owning the departmental budget and driving labour productivity, purchasing, inventory management and relevant operational KPIs, while protecting the quality of the guest experience

• Overseeing linen, uniforms, guest supplies and laundry service levels, ensuring the right balance of quality, availability and cost control

• Working closely with Front Office, Engineering and other departments to ensure arrival priorities, room readiness and special requests are seamlessly coordinated

• Promoting team well-being, safe and sustainable working practices and efficient ways of working

• Continuously reviewing processes and identifying opportunities to improve quality, productivity and the overall guest experience

About you

You have proven senior Housekeeping leadership experience, preferably from a five-star luxury hotel or a similarly high-end hospitality environment.

You are a visible and confident leader who enjoys being close to the operation and the team, while also having the ability to step back, identify opportunities and continuously develop the department.

You combine strong operational knowledge with warmth, structure and an exceptional eye for detail. You are comfortable making decisions, setting clear expectations and creating accountability, while leading with respect and genuine care for your team.

You have experience with team development, training, workforce planning, budgeting, labour productivity, inventory management and quality assurance. You communicate clearly, remain calm under pressure and enjoy working collaboratively across departments.

Most importantly, you understand that exceptional Housekeeping is not only about what a guest sees, but how the room and the experience make them feel.

Professional English is required, while Danish or other languages will be considered an advantage.

We offer

You will join one of Scandinavia's most iconic luxury hotels and take responsibility for a department that plays a defining role in the d’Angleterre experience.

Here, tradition and high standards go hand in hand with a genuine ambition to continuously evolve. You will have the opportunity to shape Housekeeping operations, develop people and processes, and contribute directly to the quality of the hotel and the experiences we create for our guests.

You will become part of an ambitious and professional environment where personalised service, development and mutual respect are at the heart of everything we do.

At Hotel d’Angleterre, we believe that exceptional luxury starts with the people behind it.

jobs.occupation: TELEPHONE AGENT

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant - Tax & Transfer Pricing
jobs.description:
Do you have an interest in Finance and want to apply your theoretical knowledge in an ambitious, international and dynamic organization? We are looking for a curious and structured student to join Orifarm as a Student Assistant in our Tax & Risk Management team

About the job

As a Student Assistant in Tax & Transfer Pricing, you will gain hands-on experience with key tax processes in a rapidly growing organization with a strong profile in the international market. You will join our Group Finance Team and work closely with ambitious colleagues.

You will work independently on various tasks after thorough training. You will always have access to help and sparring if needed. The working hours will be approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility to accommodate your studies.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Preparing Transfer Pricing documentation

• Preparing tax returns

• Supporting monthly and quarterly transfer pricing calculations and adjustments

• Participating in process improvements and digitalization initiatives

• Reporting financial data to various authorities

• Various ad-hoc assignments

Who are you?

We are looking for an ambitious student who is currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree programme in Economics (e.g., HA, HA(jur.), Cand.merc, or Finansbachelor).

We would like you to be analytical and good with numbers, providing a structured approach and the ability to maintain a good overview. You are also curious by nature and not afraid to ask questions. We value someone who is a team player and has a positive mindset. Additionally, you are able to work independently and take ownership of your tasks and responsibilities.

Who are we?

Our Global Finance team consists of 65 employees based in Odense, Poland and Czech Republic. You will be a part of the Tax & Risk Management team in Odense, consisting of 3 employees, and we have the global responsibility for all finance processes, reporting and controlling.

The team is characterized by a high degree of collaboration and mutual support. We work closely together, openly share challenges, and help one another navigate complex topics. You will work with our dedicated colleagues in an open office environment, which allows us to have a friendly and informal atmosphere.

You will join 70 other talented student assistants from diverse educational backgrounds as part of our Student Network Orifarm (SNO). SNO organizes social and professional events, allowing you to expand your network and connect with other students across functions.

Why should you work for Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, giving you a valuable start to your career. As our student assistant, you may have the opportunity to complete an internship or collaborate with us on your bachelor’s or master’s thesis. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of making affordable healthcare accessible.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.occupation: SMD Operators for a New Evening Shift
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced SMD Operator with a keen eye for quality, stable processes and precision-driven electronics manufacturing? Do you thrive in a technical environment where you take responsibility, work in a structured manner and actively contribute to a strong team? Then you could be our next experienced SMD Operator at NECAS A/S.

About the position
As an SMD Operator at NECAS, you will play a key role in the operation of our SMD lines – the heart of our electronics manufacturing. You will be responsible for setting up, monitoring and optimising processes, ensuring that production meets our high quality standards.
The electronics you help produce are used in everything from industrial and marine applications to defence and aerospace – industries where precision and reliability are essential.
You will become part of a highly skilled team and report to the Team Leader.

Your responsibilities
SMD line operation and preparation

• Operate and monitor SMD equipment, including solder paste printer, SPI, pick-and-place, AOI and reflow oven
• Prepare the line for production changeovers, including programmes, materials, feeder setup and documentation
• Ensure stable operation in accordance with production plans and work instructions
• Work with supporting processes such as the washing machine and stencil cleaner

Quality and inspection

• Carry out process and quality inspections, including visual inspection and First Article Inspection
• Analyse AOI results and respond to deviations
• Ensure the correct handling of materials and components, including batch control, traceability and shelf life
• Work in accordance with the IPC-A-610 standard (certification provided where required)
• Record defects and deviations in the quality management system

Collaboration and continuous improvement

• Ensure good communication and effective handovers between shifts
• Share knowledge and support colleagues in their daily work
• Contribute suggestions for improving processes and workflows
• Maintain order and structure in the SMD area in accordance with 5S principles

About you
We are looking for a candidate who already has solid experience in SMD production and is able to work independently in a technically demanding role.

We expect you to:

• Have a minimum of 3 years' experience with SMD equipment or electronics manufacturing
• Be structured and able to maintain an overview, even during busy periods
• Take responsibility and respond quickly when something deviates from the standard
• Be a team player who contributes positively to the team
• Have a technical understanding and an interest in working with advanced equipment
• Language: good command of English, spoken and written

What we offer
At NECAS, you will become part of a growing company where quality and professional expertise are at the heart of what we do. You will receive:

• A thorough introduction to our processes and equipment
• Opportunities for relevant training and certifications, such as IPC-A-610
• A strong team environment and an informal culture with a high level of professional expertise
• A workplace in Støvring's newest industrial area, close to the E45 motorway
• Competitive terms of employment, including pension and health insurance

About NECAS
NECAS is one of Denmark's leading EMS companies, manufacturing electronics for the industrial, marine/offshore, defence, aerospace and scientific sectors – industries where quality and precision are essential.
We are one of the few EMS manufacturers in Denmark with AS9100 certification for the aerospace industry. At NECAS, you will become part of a company experiencing significant growth, where you can develop your professional skills and help push the boundaries of Danish electronics manufacturing.

As we say: Built for trust.

How to apply
The position will be filled as soon as possible. We are inviting candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. We read all applications and will contact candidates we would like to get to know better.
If you have any questions, please contact Team Leader Mariana Surleac on +45 92 92 76 20.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc position in the research project FanVEX: Fanization of Violent Extremism on social media at the Department of Sociology, Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The Department of Sociology invites applications for a postdoctoral position in the research project FanVEX: Fanization of Violent Extremism on social media to commence by 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.
 
 The position is a full time fixed-term position for 30 months

  Introduction 
 Online fandom and violent extremism increasingly intersect on social media. Violent perpetrators may become objects of fandom, while extremist actors draw on fan practices and popular culture to circulate ideological messages and attract audiences (Warzel, 2025). As perpetrators and their admirers participate in digital communities and their practices overlap with mainstream fandom (Gartenstein-Ross et al., 2023; Davey & Ebner, 2017), established approaches to understanding radicalisation, motivations and the role of ideology face new challenges.

  FanVEX investigates how validation from fan communities may mobilise or accelerate violent action and which factors sustain participation in these communities. The project examines how fandom makes extremist content memetic and viral (Milner, 2016), combines ideology with popular culture (Driessen et al., 2025), and reproduces cultural scripts that can make violence appear conceivable, attractive or worthy of emulation. The aim is to advance theoretical and empirical understanding of these processes and generate insights relevant to prevention and threat assessment.

  FanVEX brings together researchers at the University of Copenhagen’s Department of Sociology (MOD-Lab: Microsociology of Online Deviance) and Department of Nordic Studies and Linguistics (CODEX: Copenhagen Observatory of Digital Extremism), with international partners at Malmö University and Erasmus University Rotterdam. The postdoctoral researcher will be based at the Department of Sociology and will work in close collaboration with the wider FanVEX team. Professor Jakob Demant will be the main contact for the position.

  Duties and Responsibilities
 Typically, the primary focus of a postdoctoral position will be on research. However, a certain amount of teaching obligations may be required. Additional tasks beyond research and teaching may also be considered, but to a limited extent. The university will determine the final scope of the various responsibilities, and the emphasis may vary over time.

  The postdoctoral researcher will contribute particularly to Work Package 4 (WP4), which asks: How does engagement with popular culture contribute to the expression of extremist ideologies? WP4 examines whether references to popular culture function as humour, imitation, motivation, or legitimisation.

  WP4 combines data-driven analyses with digital ethnography. Its quantitative component uses co-occurrence network analysis to investigate how references to popular culture relate to ideological discourse, including material from 4chan imageboards such as /pol/ and /b/ (2021–2027). It also examines changes over time through burst-detection analysis. The qualitative component studies online communities, including incels.is and Stormfront, to understand how popular culture, fandom and anti-fan practices are incorporated into extremist environments. The analyses are designed to inform one another.
 
 The postdoctoral researcher will be expected to:
 
 - Contribute to the design, collection and analysis of digital data for WP4, with particular emphasis on quantitative network and text-based analyses.
 
 - Integrate data-driven findings with digital ethnographic insights and, where relevant, qualitative interviews.
 
 - Apply rigorous research ethics and data-protection procedures when working with sensitive online material.
 
 - Collaborate across disciplinary boundaries and contribute to project meetings and research activities.
 
 - Produce both collaboratively authored and individually authored scholarly publications during the appointment.

  Qualification Requirements 
 Applicants should hold a PhD in sociology, media studies, criminology, communication, digital humanities or a closely related discipline. We seek a researcher who can work productively across qualitative and quantitative approaches and contribute to interdisciplinary publications. In assessing applications, we will place particular emphasis on:

   	
• Experience with digital ethnography and qualitative interviewing. 	
• Competence in quantitative network analysis and data-driven analysis of digital content, such as co-occurrence, sentiment or temporal analyses. 	
• Knowledge of research ethics, data protection and the responsible handling of sensitive personal data. 	
• An interest in online extremism, participatory cultures, popular culture and/or digital deviance. 	
• Strong analytical writing skills and the ability to work collaboratively in an interdisciplinary team.   You can find further information about the qualification requirements for postdoctoral positions here: Bekendtgørelse om stillingsstruktur for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter (in Danish only).

  You can also find further information about the postdoctoral position on our English webpage on career paths for early‑career researchers at the University of Copenhagen: Career at The University of Copenhagen.

  Strategy of the Faculty of the Social Sciences
 The Department of Sociology is part of the Faculty of the Social Sciences. The faculty is a successful academic community that strives to put knowledge into action by:

   	
• Engaging partners in the co-creation of knowledge, learning and social change. 	
• Empowering our students to become reflective and responsible citizens who have the vision, the knowledge and the competences to change society for the better. 	
• Energising global, European and Danish communities of knowledge by innovating research methodologies and by research findings with impact.   Assessment Criteria
 Applicants will primarily be assessed in relation to their research qualifications, including their publications, ability to conduct independent research and participate in research collaborations, and their experience of research management. In addition, the applicant’s research plan and research potential will be assessed in relation to the overall research project described above. 

  Teaching qualifications are not a requirement, but if the Postdoc is expected to teach, then documented teaching experience can be included in the overall assessment.  

  Application
 Please submit your application online. To apply, please click on the "Apply now" icon at the bottum of this page.
 The application must be written in English, and include the following attachments in PDF or Word format:

   	
• CV (max. 3 pages) 	
• Cover letter (max. 1 page) 	
• Documentation of qualifications (exam certificates and PhD diploma) 	
• Complete publication list (attached publications must be marked with an asterisk). The list must be structured systematically and divided into the following categories: 	
• Peer-reviewed publications: 	 		
• Monographs and anthologies 		
• Articles in journals 		
• Book chapters/anthology contributions, etc. 	 	 	
• Non-peer-reviewed publications: 	 		
• Publications disseminating research findings, etc. 	 	   You can attach a maximum of 3 publications. The publication dates must be clearly marked on the list. The selected publications must be uploaded as attachments and numbered 1-3. 

   	
• Research plan (max. 2 pages)   The plan should include a brief account of previous research, current research projects, and a forward-looking outline of the planned research contribution over the coming years. The plan should also describe your involvement in research organisation, research collaborations, and active participation in research environments at both local and international levels.

  Salary and Terms of Employment
 Terms of appointment and salary will be in accordance with an agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).
 The salary range for postdoctoral positions starts at DKK /approximately EUR 39,900 (5,300 EUR) + an 18.07 % pension contribution. It is possible to negotiate salary supplements on an annual basis.

  Recruitment Process
 After the application deadline, the Head of Department will consider advice from the appointment committee and select applicants for assessment. All applicants will be notified whether they have been shortlisted. The Head of Department will set up an expert assessment committee to assess the shortlisted applications. The selected applicants will be informed who is serving on the committee. Each shortlisted applicant will be offered the opportunity to comment on the committee's assessment before the appointment is announced.

  You can find further information on our recruitment process at: Recruitment process.

  International Applicant?
 The University of Copenhagen offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including support before and during your relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about our services at: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen.

  An Equal Opportunity Workplace
 The University of Copenhagen is committed in its pursuit of academic excellence to equality of oppertunity and to creating an inclusive working environment and therefore encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, ethnicity ect. To learn more about our diverse workplace and our participation in the HRS4R HR Excellence in Research, please visit HR Excellence in Research – University of Copenhagen

  Contact Information
 For additional information about the position, please contact Jakob Demant at email: jd@soc.ku.dk

  For more Information about the recruitment process, please contact HR South at hr-soendre@adm.ku.dk. Please refer to ID number: 211-2733/26-2I.

  The application deadline is 3 January 2027 at 23:59 [CET] 
 Any applications or additional material submitted after the deadline will not be considered. However, changes may be made to the submitted application right up until the deadline.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Stimuli-Triggered Nanoparticles and T-Cell Therapeutics for Improved Treatment of Malignant Brain Tumors - DTU Health Tech
jobs.description:
If you have a strong research interest in advanced drug delivery, cancer immunotherapy and the development of innovative treatments for brain cancer, this might be the right PhD position for you.

The aim of the PhD project is to develop a novel targeted drug delivery platform for the treatment of glioblastoma. The project combines genetically engineered CAR T cells with stimuli-responsive nanoparticles and in vitro and in vivo characterization the developed platform. 

As a PhD student you will be a part of the Pharmaceutical Technology group at DTU Health Tech. Find more information at www.healthtech.dtu.dk/research/research-sections/section-idun.

In the group, we are exploring and developing targeted and advanced delivery systems to be able to e.g. deliver small molecules, biologics and vaccines. The ultimate goals of these activities are to enhance the systemic uptake, to prevent and/or cure diseases. The group is part of the Drug Delivery and Sensing (IDUN) section at DTU Department of Health Technology. Furthermore, the PhD project is in close collaboration with researchers at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) and Skåne University Hospital.

Responsibilities
Primarily, you will be working in the research area of nanoparticles, cancer immune therapy and brain delivery. 

The research tasks include: 

• Develop stimuli-sensitive nanoparticles and in vitro characterize these 
• Engineer CAR-T cells 
• In vitro cell characterization 
• In vivo studies to determine effect of the developed platforms.
The project will be carried out in close collaboration with colleagues from the IDUN section, SDU, UCPH and Skåne University Hospital.

Qualifications
The ideal candidate for the position will feature the following profile:

• Dynamic, independent, creative and goal-oriented
• Strong technical background in nanoparticle development
• Knowledge and hands-on experience with cell handling 
• Experience with immune therapy and in vivo studies 
• Capable of handling a multifaceted project with many stakeholders and collaborators
You are expected to have a background in areas related to pharmaceutical sciences/technology, chemistry or biomaterials. Furthermore, you are expected to be highly independent, self-motivated and enjoy collaboration in a multidisciplinary academic environment. Moreover, you should have the ability to drive the project forward and to set and achieve ambitious goals. You should also enjoy supervising and teaching BSc and MSc students. The project is highly interdisciplinary and we expect that you enjoy teamwork and are good at coordinating your work with your colleagues. 

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Assoc. Prof. Line Hagner Nielsen and Assoc. Prof. Maria Ormhøj.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years.The position is a full-time position. Starting date is 1 April 2027 or according to mutual agreement. 

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Associate Prof. Line Hagner Nielsen, lihan@dtu.dk.

You can read more about DTU Health Tech at www.healthtech.dtu.dk/english.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 12 January 2027 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Health Tech engages in research, education, and innovation base on technical and natural science for the healthcare sector. The Healthcare sector is a globally expanding market with demands for the most advanced technological solutions. DTU Health Tech creates the foundation for companies to develop new and innovative services and products which benefit people and create value for society. DTU Health Techs expertise spans from imaging and biosensor techniques, across digital health and biological modelling, to biopharma technologies. The department has a scientific staff of about 210 persons, 140 PhD students and a technical/administrative support staff of about 160 persons, of which a large majority contributes to our research infrastructure and related commercial activities.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer – Veo+
jobs.description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

You’ll report to the Engineering Manager be part of a cross-functional product team working closely with engineers, product managers, and product designers to build and evolve these tools.

jobs.occupation: Senior Account Executive, Net New
jobs.description:
**Your work days are brighter here.

**We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About The Team

**Workmates pride themselves on winning while having fun! That means supporting each other while driving accountability for amazing results and performance. This team is no different. Everything we do inspires a brighter work day for all. The Enterprise Sales team at Workday helps the company to continue to grow by balancing integrity and innovation, ensuring Workmates have the environment to bring their best self, and get better by pushing and developing themselves and the Workmates around them.

**About The Role

**Here at Workday, our Account Executives are key players in our Field Sales organization. With a net new revenue focus, they are the fuel for Workday’s new customer growth. This fantastic team of hardworking professionals play a key role in guiding new customers on a journey that can see them leave the limitations of legacy platforms behind and move forward with a new class of enterprise management cloud and AI solutions. As a team, we believe that in partnering with our customers to craft relevant solutions that deliver long lasting value is super important. We want to make sure that our customers are positively satisfied from day one and forever ongoing. In this role, you will:

• Develop strategy for prioritizing, targeting, and closing key opportunities in assigned territory: Professional Business Services, Technology, Media and Engineering/Construction, 60+ accounts with 1000+ users

• Perform account planning for assigned accounts, coordinating with pre-sales and other resources to ensure strategic alignment

• Initiate and support sales of Workday solutions within Medium Enterprise prospects and shares Workday value propositions

• Maintain accurate and timely customer/prospect, pipeline, and service forecast data

**About You

**Basic Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience selling SaaS/Cloud based ERP / HCM / Financial / Planning / or Analytics solutions to C-levels from a field sales position - including proven experience of selling AI solutions

• 4+ years experience negotiating deals with a variety of C-Suite Executives to close opportunities

• 4+ years experience in engaging in a programmatic approach to generate and develop leads within your territory

• Fluent Danish language skills

**Other Qualifications

**

• Proven track record in a high-velocity sales cycle, including prospecting for a portion of opportunities

• Understanding of the the strategic competitive landscape of the industry by staying up to date with trends and customer needs so you can effectively position Workday solutions within accounts

• Experience leveraging and partnering with internal team members on account strategies

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Workday Pay Transparency Statement (For EU Locations Only)

**Listed below is the base salary range applicable to this position. Workday pay ranges (and the precise pay offered to the successful candidate) are based on a number of objective criteria such as relevant experience and skills, and educational qualifications, level of responsibility, demands of the role, work location and business need. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Primary Location Base Pay Range: kr694,000 DKK - kr1,041,000 DKK Denmark

**Our Approach to Flexible Work

**With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.

Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!

**At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.

Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.

In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

jobs.occupation: VIKING is looking for a Student Assistant, Global Processes & Learning
jobs.description:
JOIN VIKING - and become a lifesaver
Are you looking for a student job in an international company with a clear purpose of saving lives?

Are you motivated by being part of a global team that supports learning, development and organizational growth?

If so, you might be the person we are looking for as our new Student Assistant in People & Organization, Global Processes & Learning.

At VIKING, we live by saving lives. We are proud to be a world-leading supplier of safety products, solutions, and services to the global maritime industry, protecting people on offshore platforms, ferries, fishing vessels, cargo ships, and superyachts around the world.

Your primary tasks:

As our Student Assistant, you will support the Global Processes & Learning team with a variety of operational and development related tasks, including:

• Setting up and maintaining courses in SuccessFactors
• Helping coordinate global learning activities and making practical arrangements for courses
• Maintaining and creating SharePoint pages
• Preparing presentations, documents and other materials
• Checking data and information for quality and following up when something is off
• Supporting improvements to HR processes, tools and strategic HR projects
What you will gain:

This position offers a unique opportunity to gain practical experience within Global HR, learning and development, digital tools, and project work in a truly international organization.

As you grow in the role, you will have the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility and become involved in a wide range of exciting projects and initiatives.

The position is approximately 15 hours per week, and we offer flexibility during exam periods.

Student Assistants play an important role at VIKING. Many of our student employees also complete internships with us and write their theses based on real-life business challenges and projects.

When you join VIKING, you will become part of our strong Young VIKING Network, bringing together more than 40 ambitious trainees, graduates, and student assistants. The network is designed to support both personal and professional development while offering a strong social community across the organization.

Learn more about the Young VIKING Network here: https://www.viking-life.com/careers/young-viking-network/

What we are looking for:

We imagine that you:

• Are currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree within Human Resources, Business Administration, Communication, Learning, or a related field
• Have at least 18 months remaining of your studies
• Are structured, detail-oriented, and responsible
• Take ownership of your tasks and follow them through from start to finish
• Are comfortable communicating and collaborating with stakeholders across different functions and levels of the organization
• Have strong English communication skills, both written and spoken
Experience with SharePoint or learning systems is an advantage, but not a requirement.

VIKING offers:

We offer a rewarding position that provides opportunities for personal and professional growth in collaboration with colleagues, who value humour, job satisfaction and a great work environment.

VIKING is a global workplace where the majority of our activities address the whole world. We have a strong culture and give space to the individual – we know everyone brings a unique contribution. That’s why we invest in our employees and offer unique career opportunities in an international organization.

We also offer:

• A strong commitment to well-being and work-life balance
• Good health insurance coverage
• Special discounts in local shops
• An active employee association that arranges various social events
Do you want to be a part of VIKING ?

All applications are received online by “Send application” in the job add. We conduct interviews continuously and therefore recommend you send your application and resume as soon as possible. All applications are naturally handled with confidentiality.

Start date is as soon as possible, however we don’t mind waiting for the right candidate.

If you have questions concerning the position or VIKING, you are welcome to reach out to HR Business Partner Søren Langelund on phone +45 2542 8240 or by e-mail SL@viking-life.com.

Read more at www.viking-life.com

JOIN VIKING - YOUR CAREER IS SAFE WITH US
